_source: Prices: OpenAI developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing, Anthropic platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing, mistral.ai/pricing/api, DeepSeek api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing and Groq console.groq.com/docs/models, read on 2026-09-21 through a page summariser. USD per 1M tokens, standard tier. Check them before you rely on a number. The Gemini models are in gemini_models.json. OpenAI prices and shutdown dates re-read on 2026-10-27 (developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing and /deprecations); claude-sonnet-5-5 from platform.claude.com on the same day (T-02.6).
_works_today: tested = run end to end through this agent's pipeline with this project's key (0 problems in the answers). should work, untested = the provider's API accepts what the agent sends, but there is no key in .env to try it. needs adapter change = the agent would have to change to use it (see adapter_note).
_ratings: The ratings are estimates from the size and description of each model, NOT measurements. Only the models marked tested were run here.
_output_multiplier: Tokens billed as output per visible output token, for models whose reasoning is counted inside the output (measured for gpt-oss: about 2.5x; assumed for the other reasoning models).
